title: XuVerse
summary: A personal portfolio that brings software projects, writing, research, and media into one place.
home_summary: A portfolio for software, writing, and media.
description: Built as a PHP and MySQL portfolio with content management, project records, writing, media, a resume, and contact options. Versioned public content and one Publish workflow connect its local preview, GitHub revision, and PHP-hosted release.
role: Personal project: development and content curation
learning: Connecting content, administration, responsive layouts, and deployment into one maintainable site.
image_alt: XuVerse homepage with B K Suraj's name and portrait beside links to his work and About page.

title: Lost & Found Management System
summary: An academic web prototype for recording and finding lost items.
description: An academic PHP and MySQL web prototype with authentication, item uploads, search, and administration. Its records and access controls support reporting and finding lost items.
learning: Designing useful records and access controls around a simple campus problem.
image_alt: Lost and Found title in yellow over a forest photograph.
image_caption: Cover artwork for the Lost & Found project.

title: Hotel Reservation Manager
summary: A C++ console project for room availability, guest records, and reservations.
description: An object-oriented academic project using room subclasses, reservation and guest records, simulated card payment handling, and text-file persistence. It demonstrates encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and composition. Payment handling is a simulation; a payment gateway and working login system are not implemented.
learning: Turning a UML design into classes with clear responsibilities and working reservation flows.
